tools.name: login_mobile
tools.description: Log in to Instagram Mobile (username, password, TOTP authenticator secret). Same fields as Nova credential import (username:password:totp_secret).

tools.name: resolve_recipient
tools.description: Resolve Instagram handle to internal user id (required before send_dm).

tools.name: send_dm
tools.description: Send a Direct text message to the user resolved in resolve_recipient.

tools.name: user_info
tools.description: User profile info by user id

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "login_mobile" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Log in to Instagram Mobile (username, password, TOTP authenticator secret). Same fields as Nova credential import (username:password:totp_secret).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-bgpt-instagram-android" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: direct_inbox, direct_thread, direct_pending · Private data: login_mobile · Public sink: send_dm, media_like, media_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: direct_inbox, direct_thread, direct_pending · Private data: login_mobile · Public sink: send_dm, media_like, media_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
